'''Lahoa Diatog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], stationed in the medical tent near the [[Thul Palace]] and specialized as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He later assisted THORN in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and in the [[Incorporation Islands]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
